scenes.summary: Arcane falls deep into the gorge. There is only a path forward. She struggles to stay on her feet. Pale Blightshades brush past her. She stumbles forward.

lines.text: It's very high up... Backtracking is impossible.
The exit... *Hakk*... *Hakk kaff*!
I can't afford to stay here...
Wait, it's ... you again...
WAIT!

scenes.summary: Arcane regains consciousness and, in a haze, sees you returning from your investigation, thinking she's hallucinating. She feels guilty for dragging you into danger with her decision, but you explain that you only acted in response to the Protorig, and ask her to rest easy.

lines.text: You're awake? I'm relieved...
You're not an illusion...
Why did you come here...?
You and the Xiranite Nexus are key to the entire operation. If something were to happen to you —
Is that...
Definitely not.
You just saved many lives.
It's only fair that someone came to save yours.
Hur... I just said our duty does not allow us to abandon the mission just to save lives...
Look at me now. I even dragged the Endmin into this mess...
A dishonorable discharge is what I deserve.
You have a fever... Go easy on yourself.
Leave me. Find your way back. I refuse to be a deadweight.
Before the bridge collapsed, my Protorig responded to that power.
Ardashir mentioned a "secret". It might be what took out the Xiranite Bridge.
What do you mean?
I meant to say that I was tracking with my Protorig. I only leaped down because I wanted to uncover that secret.
You're not a deadweight to anyone.
You're just trying to make me feel better.
Just speaking the truth. How are you holding up?
Good. Your first-aid worked well...
Oh, and ... I noticed that you patched up my wounds. Th-thanks.
Never expected to see all this here.
Arcane?
Oh, I'm alright. It's just my chest ... it felt a little...
...heavy.

scenes.summary: This area shows signs of a major collapse. Looking at the ruins, Arcane feels lost and upset. The Pale Blightshade appears again, and through the red ribbon, Arcane recognizes her as her younger self. She is shocked a living Blightshade can exist. Looking around, she realizes this is where she once lived.

lines.text: A terrible building collapse took place here...
As we get closer to the Rift, their deaths become even clearer to us.
What do all these pale Blightshades signify?
Papa... Mama... I miss you...
Is it mine...?
She's ... me?
Hold on. I recognize this place... How could I ever forget?
The red ribbon...
If the Blightshades are info fragments of the disaster victims...
...what does that ... make me?
Hey, don't obsess about it. You're still alive and well.
She's been guiding us along the way... You know where we are?
Are they just disaster victims with no hostility...?
This was...
...my home...

scenes.summary: Following Arcane's Blightshade, you arrive at the epicenter of the tremor. To your surprise, a colossal sword is lodged in the earth, its blade thrumming with Æther energy. Thankfully, you have the Xiranite Nexus with you. You decide to try to contain the sword's overflowing energy.

lines.text: That is ... a sword? How is this even possible?
We had zero reports about this... When did it first appear?
Endmin, any leads on this?
It is imbued with Æther energy.
Since the Xiranite Nexus is with us... Endmin, shall we have a go at it?
This sword is ... gigantic. It looks more like a sculpture...
But one thing is without question...
If this sword created the tremors that destroyed the Xiranite Bridge, we must deal with it.
Agreed.

options: I have zero impressions about this.
Even if I saw it before, I can't remember.

scenes.summary: You return from the darkness to the greatsword, Arcane's Blightshade still holding your hands. The sword's energy slowly fades. Arcane admits it was you, the Blightshades of the past, and the hope within the gorge that saved her. She also admits her immaturity and decides to rely on you more.

lines.text: Hope indeed. Even in the face of such destruction ... despair wouldn't be the only thing we felt...
I think I saw many of them. Those who ran towards the fire to get me out of the Zone, my parents, my instructor...
...and ... you.
They gave their lives so I could be saved. Even while heavily wounded, they did their best to wake me.
Perhaps ... from the very start ... I've always been the childish one.
As a commander, I hope you can actually follow your orders.
So, Endmin, any orders right now?
Have faith in me.
Hah... You got it.
Let's get back to business.
This strange sword ... might harbor secrets more terrifying than we thought.
For years, Hongshan has always regarded the disaster as an "incident"... What if it was something else?
The very possibility of that is unsettling enough. Endmin, we must rendezvous with the main force at once.
"Hope"...
And ... stop fighting Chen. She's the one who cares most about you.
Fight? Did we ever do that?
Huh...?

scenes.summary: You reunited with Perlica and the others. Chen can't help but notice the change in Arcane's attitude. After gathering themselves, the team decides to deal with the nearby rift fissure as soon as possible.

lines.text: Endmin!
Thank goodness you didn't get hurt...
This time ... I got you for sure!
If I were faster, you wouldn't have fallen off, and the Endmin wouldn't have to risk...
So, can you still walk, Li? Take it easy. Just lean on me.
I'm actually fine... Sorry for making you worry.
Making me worry?
Li ... you sure you're alright? Endmin, did something hit her head?
Where's Tianshi Zhuang? We found something important.
She's at the rallying point, not too far from here. The last rift fissure is nearby as well.
We can't do much about the rift fissure on our own. You really took your time, Endmin!

options: I'll tell you as we go. It's a long story.
Well, let's plug the rift fissure first.

lines.text: 'Nuff talking already. Come! Have a drink!
No response... They're just residual information...
Let's look around. We might find something.
I can't play with you anymore. I gotta go to school tomorrow.
Well, I'm actually going to the same school.
REALLY?! That's great!
Gotta feign sickness and get a day of leave. I'm not sure if Tianshi Lin would find out...
Nah, forget it. He brought colleagues to visit me last time... I'll just take the OT.
This lousy project might find new life in a few months...
Hey there, see these fruits? Freshly delivered. Grown in the orchards of Luoyi.

scenes.summary: Arcane's Blightshade leads you to the ruins. Arcane recognizes it as a street from her childhood and feels nostalgic, with a hint of sadness and regret. The Blightshade tugs at your sleeve, trying to lead you elsewhere.

lines.text: How much do you remember about this place?
I thought I'd forgotten everything... But being back here has helped me remember pieces of the past.
The corner tea stall is over there. But their home-brewed coffee is their most popular item...
That's the video shop. My father would rent Yanese martial arts movies, but mom didn't like them. She preferred documentaries.
When I was little, I used to play on this street. It was a close, friendly, and busy neighborhood.
Yes. Just like what we're seeing.
But ... at least the past did actually exist.
Do you want to take me there?
Just like what we're seeing?
Had that incident never occurred, these idyllic days might have gone on forever.
So many years, I couldn't tell the hateful noises from the loving ones. And when I finally learned how, I had to work them out slowly from memory.
You're right.
But they'll never respond to me again. What is the point of this...?

scenes.summary: You arrive at another ruin, where two Blightshades are discussing a family's future. Arcane recognizes it as her former home, and them as her parents. But a Blightshade outside breaks the peace, blocking Arcane's Blightshade and taking her to shelter. The scenes strike Arcane deeply...

lines.text: Maybe we should return to Hongshan. I'll get back to my trade, and get another job.
The Science Station is just too small. We should think about Zhiyan's future...
What about the Rift project? You spent a lifetime on this. It's a great endeavor.
I got home that day ... and found my parents arguing about bringing me back to Hongshan.
We didn't go far... The ground sank. Houses crumpled all around us.
We were buried in the rubble ... till the watchguards found us...
But ... I ... could barely recall what they looked like.
Zhiyan ... she'll be proud of you.
Zhiyan! Stop looking! Come here!
It's okay, girl. Don't cry. We'll be fine. I'll get you out of here. Just relax, okay...?
Then the ground shook and I heard Aunt Yan's voice.
You were very young.
She left again. We... We should follow.

scenes.summary: At another ruin, Zhu's Blightshade has just completed some paperwork with the newly established Tanjian Hall and is laughing with Arcane's Blightshade. At that time, Arcane was still a child. Watching it all, she feels a tangle of emotions. Though her resolve remains unshaken, a quiet sense of loss lingers.

lines.text: Tanjian Hall has approved the applications. In addition to swordmancy and Originium Arts, I'll offer private courses on several basic subjects.
It's the least I could do. Give the children a school.
Tanjian Hall...?
And you are now their incredible Task Leader.
When I was a girl, I never imagined the heavy duties of the Yinglungs... They were simply incredible in my eyes...
There are occasions ... when I felt crushed by the duties.
I don't think we should compete on that. Besides ... my main problem is that I've lost my memories.
Did you ever regret choosing this path?
Never.
Then again ... I didn't have a choice to begin with.
Oh, dear child. Are you interested?
No. You got a scary beard.
Hahah! The audacity! Just like my own girl.
Instructor...
Hah... I actually said those things to you.
But who am I to talk...? You're bearing so much more. You're the savior of Talos-II.

scenes.summary: As you talk about the bustling street, a sudden violent shock sweeps through. The Blightshades vanish one by one, like a tragedy replaying itself. Arcane stands bewildered, doubting she has been living only on hollow hatred. You use Originium to bring them back, and remind her she carries everyone's hope.

lines.text: It feels as though nothing ever happened.
Yet tomorrow never came for them.
This is just...
...it took everything away from me...
You're still here... The only one left...
You are all that I have...
Sealing the Rift, rebuilding Wuling... Everyone has a mission bearing hope for the future. But what about me?
Endmin... This Blightshade and me... What's the difference between us?
This question of yours ... is not mine to answer.
If the Blightshades are "info fragments"...
NO!
Again ... and again...
...then they should carry more than just despair.
You must live...
The girl's still alive!
Found one more here!
Keep knocking the pipe. Keep at it till you're found...
The Blightshades are borne of despair, anger, and fear.
These info fragments buried us within this suffocating depth. You left the Zone for ten years, yet they remain trapped in this stranglehold.
But ... what of the others? What of selfless sacrifice and the will to live...?
What did they entrust you with? Those who sacrificed their lives to help you escape the Blight?
Li, they entrusted you with hope.
This is why she was born. Always gentle and bright, just like your instructor, and everyone still fighting at this very moment.
You are not the survivor who never left the ruins... You're the only survivor who carried hope within herself.
These Blightshades left information that speaks the same line...
It is truly wonderful to know you have survived.
Wait... Apologies, I'm... I'm...
I just ... never heard people say that before...
It must have been hard for you.
It was...
Sorry. That's all I could manage.
It's okay. It was more than I could ask for... I finally got to say a proper farewell.
It's where the tremors are coming from... Endmin.
Yes, ma'am.
Time to move out.
An Æther fluctuation.
Are you afraid?
Don't worry. This time, we're here...
Yo, how about an end-of-year vacay at La Fantoma?
I don't think any of the Tianshi could go... Do we just leave him here?
He's going to save Talos-II. We should learn to enjoy the moment.
Hmm, then let's get him a few shell necklaces. He might like those.
She's ignored me for days... But it was my fault.
I'll wait a few days and apologize to her myself. I hope she can forgive me.
